def solve():
    target = 290
    held = 60
    vintage = 2024
    eligible = vintage >= 2020
    bundle_size = 100
    price = Q("9.25")
    resale_price = price * Q("0.9")
    legacy_price = Q("4.5")

    if eligible:
        applied = min(held, target)
        surplus_held = held - applied
        legacy_proceeds = Q(0)
    else:
        applied = 0
        surplus_held = 0
        legacy_proceeds = held * legacy_price

    shortfall = target - applied
    # fewest whole bundles covering shortfall (ceiling division)
    bundles = -(-shortfall // bundle_size) if shortfall > 0 else 0
    bought = bundles * bundle_size
    bundle_excess = bought - shortfall if shortfall > 0 else 0
    surplus = bundle_excess + surplus_held

    purchase_cost = bought * price
    resale = surplus * resale_price
    net = purchase_cost - resale - legacy_proceeds

    return {
        "final": net,
        "applied_held_credits": applied,
        "bundles_purchased": bundles,
        "surplus_credits": surplus,
    }
